# tasks

Scan tasks and their lifecycle (start/stop/resume/clone).

- Toolset name: `tasks`
- Enabled by default: yes
- Tools: 9 (2 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_clone_task`

**Clone task** · mutating

Clone a scan task (configuration only, no reports). Returns the UUID of the copy.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_create_task`

**Create task** · mutating

Create a scan task. Classic tasks bind a target, scan config and scanner; other variants use their own selector (agent group, OCI image target, web application target); `type: "import"` creates a container task for report imports. Returns the new task's UUID; the task is not started automatically.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent_group_id` | string | no | UUID of the agent group (agentGroup tasks) |
| `alert_ids` | array<string> | no | Optional alert UUIDs to attach |
| `alterable` | boolean | no | Whether the task stays modifiable after the first run |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Task name |
| `observers` | array<string> | no | Login names of users allowed to observe the task |
| `oci_image_target_id` | string | no | UUID of the OCI image target (ociImage tasks) |
| `preferences` | object<string, string> | no | Key-value scan preferences, e.g. {"max_checks": "4"} |
| `scan_config_id` | string | no | UUID of the scan config (required for classic tasks, rejected for other variants) |
| `scanner_id` | string | no | UUID of the scanner (required for every non-import task) |
| `schedule_id` | string | no | Optional schedule UUID |
| `schedule_periods` | integer | no | Number of schedule periods to run (0 = unlimited) |
| `target_id` | string | no | UUID of the scan target (classic tasks) |
| `type` | string | no | Task variant: "classic" (default; host target + scan config), "agentGroup", "ociImage", "webApplication" or "import" (a container task for openvas_import_report that accepts only name/comment). Non-classic variants are inferred from their selector when omitted. |
| `web_application_target_id` | string | no | UUID of the web application target (webApplication tasks) |

### `openvas_delete_task`

**Delete task** · destructive

Delete a scan task (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_get_task`

**Get task** · read-only

Get one scan task by UUID, including scan config, scanner, schedule and report references.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_list_tasks`

**List tasks** · read-only

List scan tasks with status and progress. Returns summarized rows plus pagination; use openvas_get_task for full details of one task.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | string | no | GMP filter expression, e.g. `name~webserver and severity>5` |
| `filter_id` | string | no | UUID of a saved filter to apply |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, 1-indexed (default 1) (min 0) |
| `per_page` | integer | no | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 25) (min 0) |

### `openvas_resume_task`

**Resume task** · mutating

Resume a stopped scan task. Returns the UUID of the report the resumed run writes to.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |

### `openvas_update_task`

**Update task** · destructive

Update a scan task's bindings or metadata. Idempotent (PUT): omitted fields stay unchanged; fails with 409 while the task is running.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alert_ids` | array<string> | no | Replacement alert UUIDs |
| `alterable` | boolean | no |  |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the task to update |
| `name` | string | no |  |
| `observers` | array<string> | no | Replacement observer login names |
| `preferences` | object<string, string> | no | Key-value scan preferences |
| `scan_config_id` | string | no | Replacement scan config UUID |
| `scanner_id` | string | no | Replacement scanner UUID |
| `schedule_id` | string | no | Replacement schedule UUID |
| `schedule_periods` | integer | no |  |
| `target_id` | string | no | Replacement target UUID |
